name: store-pos
description: **An integrated Point of Sale and Business Management System for a General Store and LPG Gas Business.**

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:database && npm run lint:frontend
